categories.main_business_segments: Xi'an Sinofuse Electric Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of circuit protection components, focusing on power fuses, excitation fuses (high-speed circuit breakers), and intelligent fuses (smart high-speed circuit breakers). Their products serve key sectors including new energy vehicles, new energy photovoltaic and wind power generation, energy storage, communication, rail transit, and data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced fuse technology including design of fuse elements, materials application, manufacturing processes, and product testing. They have developed multiple voltage platform series (500VDC, 1000VDC, 1500VDC) for excitation and intelligent fuses, and employ flexible, customized production with continuous upgrades in automation and digital management systems such as ERP, MES, PLM, and QMS. They hold 279 patents, including 33 invention patents, with a strong focus on innovation and rapid product development cycles (3-6 months for new products).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international companies in new energy vehicles (e.g., CATL, BYD, Tesla, Daimler), new energy photovoltaic and energy storage (e.g., Sungrow, Huawei, Goldwind), communication (e.g., Huawei, ZTE), and rail transit (e.g., CRRC, GE Transportation). The company serves major OEMs and system integrators in these sectors, focusing on mid-to-high-end market segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It also has an expanding international footprint with subsidiaries and operations in Europe (Germany), North America (USA), Asia (South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Hong Kong), and actively develops overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xi'an Sinofuse Electric operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying circuit protection components to OEMs and system integrators in new energy and industrial sectors. It manages procurement of raw materials and components, production, and direct sales to end customers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening its core fuse technology, expanding product lines to include intelligent and excitation fuses, and developing solutions for emerging markets such as AI data centers, eVOLT, and embodied intelligence. It prioritizes R&D investment to accelerate product innovation, enhance automation, and expand international market share. Key R&D projects include customized fuses for international automakers, high-voltage intelligent fuses, and new technology applications in energy storage and lightning protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of various types of fuses and related components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with customized production based on customer orders. It also receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the power fuse industry, competing with international well-known brands in the mid-to-high-end market segments. It has established a strong brand reputation and stable partnerships with major domestic and international customers, leveraging its innovation and rapid product development to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.42 billion, a 34.11% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 187 million, up 59.80%. Total assets reached RMB 2.24 billion, growing 33.03%. The company has shown consistent revenue and profit growth driven by expanding sales in new energy vehicles and renewable energy sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable fuse products with comprehensive certifications (IATF16949, ISO/TS22163, UL, TÜV, CB, CE) and a broad product portfolio covering diverse voltage levels and applications. Its rapid product development cycle, strong R&D capabilities, and ability to provide customized, integrated energy protection solutions differentiate it in the market. The company also focuses on intelligent and high-voltage fuse technologies to meet evolving industry demands.
